comments.author: @yodorob
comments.text: In a different circumstance in which Argentina/Uruguay (hereafter, Argentina - as one single country on both sides of the Plate) would have either been incorporated into the British Empire or else would have become more strongly British-influenced than in reality (albeit without being actually in the British Empire), the Falklands might by now be Argentine without any conflict, after having been separate - Newfoundland-style - until 1949 or so.
